title: Todos Create Checklist Permission Consistency

database.reason: No persistence model changes are introduced.

migration.reason: The existing fair_crm.todos.update permission is reused.

backend.reason: Existing ReplaceTodoSteps authorization remains unchanged and authoritative.

audit.reason: Existing todo/checklist persistence behavior is unchanged.

menu.reason: No navigation menu changes are introduced.

route_guard.reason: Todos route access is unchanged; only the secondary checklist mutation is hardened.

notes: TodoForm already strips checklist steps when todos.update is missing. TodosPage now independently guards its post-create replaceTodoSteps mutation with canUpdate, while create-only users can still create the Todo itself.
